newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 6.723 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 6.723 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 98-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.723 percent versus 6.754 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 189-day treasury bills was 6.72 percent versus 6.765 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 350-day treasury bills was 6.802 percent versus 6.89 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
